reviews.author: Lina Vu
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this homestay. The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and well equipped with everything we needed for our trip. The location was excellent—very convenient for getting around, with plenty of great restaurants, cafés, and shops just a short walk away.

The host was also fantastic: very friendly, responsive, and always happy to help with any questions or requests. Communication was smooth from check-in to check-out, which made our stay even more enjoyable.

We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

reviews.author: Thanhtruc Le
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay here and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Hai Phong!

From the moment we arrived, the host was waiting outside to greet us and made us feel so welcome. They even provided us with extra bottled water and were always happy to help with anything we needed throughout our stay.

The location is very convenient, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, convenience stores, drinks, and snacks all within walking distance.

At first, we were a little skeptical because you have to walk through a small alley to reach the homestay. However, the alley is very short, spacious, and well-lit, so it ended up not being an issue at all.

The host is incredibly responsive, kind, and helpful. Whenever we had a question or needed assistance, they replied right away. Being able to communicate in English was also a huge bonus.

The cleanliness was honestly one of the highlights of our stay. We've stayed at several places in Hai Phong, and this was by far the cleanest. Everything was spotless, and the rooms were modern, comfortable, and beautifully maintained.
